associations.rationale: This is an Ext Kunneth equivalence in a finite-dimensional special case, but it does not state the packet's finite-projective-resolution hypotheses; it supports the corrected result rather than matching that formulation.

The type displays the finite projective hypotheses and an Ext isomorphism, but the sigma-object index p has an elided type, so the required complementary-degree constraint is not directly visible in the formula.
